description: Read only. Whether the business's CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive or monday.com) is connected to Taseli, when it was last pulled, how many deals the last pull read and how many matched an ad lead, which open CRM stages are still on 'not yet' (their deals teach the ad platforms nothing until the owner maps them in Taseli's Leads › CRM page), and what currently blocks the lead loop: the top reason good leads and closed deals do not reach Google and Meta, in plain words, per ad account, and whether the owner can fix it. Also says how many deals from the CRM reached each platform in the last 30 days. Useful for 'is my CRM connected?', 'are my deals reaching Google?', 'why does Google not know which leads closed?'. Only counts, stage names and the CRM's name are returned, never contacts. Connecting or mapping is done by the owner in Taseli, not here.

account.description: An ad account's name, to see its lead-loop blocker only; omit for all of them.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.
